_doc: Great massifs (bead bzc.145, docs/art/classes/mountains.md): one more declutter step after the range-massifs set: a range's interior is laid from a few great forms about three cells wide (about 240 px), three or four summits on one body, whose lower slopes are the colour of the family's own ground and taper out at both sides. generate-image-v2 at native display size, never downscaled or mirrored. Layers: style, light, class-great-massif, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one great green grassy mountain range, each image a different one of these: three rounded summits on one long ridge with grassy spurs, a high green mountain with a grey rocky crown and two lower summits beside it, four soft summits of different heights on one broad body. Its slopes are the meadow grass of the plain around it: grass #8bb95e, lit #a6cf6e on the left faces, shadow #5e8f45 and deep gullies #44703c on the right faces; a little bare rock #9a978a on top. Fills the full image width and nearly its full height.
